name: Crawl4AI v0.9 LLM-Ready Web Crawler
description: Turn websites into clean markdown for LLMs with a headless browser.

PORT.description: Port the Crawl4AI server listens on (gunicorn on all IPv4/IPv6 interfaces). Railway routes the domain and healthcheck here.

CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN.description: Operator token for every endpoint except /health and the UI shells. Send it as 'Authorization: Bearer ...'. Without it the server only listens on loopback.

SECRET_KEY.description: Signs JWTs: the internal MCP tool calls and the short-lived client tokens issued by POST /token. Keep it stable; at least 32 characters.

REDIS_HOST.description: Redis for job status/results and monitor stats (private network). Set to localhost to use the bundled in-container Redis instead.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Redis password (also protects the bundled loopback Redis).

REDIS_TASK_TTL.description: Seconds that /crawl/job and /llm/job results stay retrievable in Redis.

CRAWL4AI_MAX_PAGES.description: Global cap on browser pages open at the same time (upstream default 40). Lower it to bound RAM; each page needs roughly 50-150 MB.

CRAWL4AI_BROWSER_IDLE_TTL.description: Seconds before an idle pooled browser is closed (upstream default 300). Lower values return RAM sooner after bursts.

CRAWL4AI_MEMORY_THRESHOLD.description: Container memory percent (cgroup-aware) above which no new browsers are started (upstream default 95).

CRAWL4AI_JOB_WORKERS.description: Concurrent background workers for /crawl/job and /llm/job (upstream default 4).

CRAWL4AI_RATE_LIMIT.description: API rate limit per client address, e.g. 1000/minute (upstream default).

CRAWL4AI_CORS_ORIGINS.description: Optional comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API directly (CORS is deny-by-default).

LLM_PROVIDER.description: Optional default model for LLM extraction in LiteLLM provider/model form, e.g. anthropic/{model}. Empty = upstream default openai/gpt-4o-mini.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables LLM extraction (/llm, /llm/job, LLM strategies) with OpenAI models. Plain crawling needs no key.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. For anthropic/* models; also set LLM_PROVIDER.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. For gemini/* models; also set LLM_PROVIDER.

RAILWAY_SHM_SIZE_BYTES.description: Shared memory (/dev/shm) for Chromium: 1 GiB, as upstream recommends (--shm-size=1g). Railway's default is 64 MB.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period on redeploy so running crawls can finish (matches gunicorn's 30 s graceful timeout).

REDISHOST.description: Private network hostname of the Redis service, only resolvable from services in the same environment

REDIS_URL.description: Connection string for connecting to Redis using the private network

REDISPASSWORD.description: Alias of REDIS_PASSWORD for clients that expect the unseparated name

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Randomly generated password for authenticating with Redis
